fullContentHtml:
SSB Head Constable Ministerial Result 2026 – Full Details

Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has released the result for the post of Head Constable (Ministerial). This recruitment was released for 115 posts. Applications for the SSB Head Constable Ministerial Recruitment 2021 were accepted from July 24, 2021, to August 28, 2021. The written examination was held on 07 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SSB Head Constable Ministerial Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 July 2021
  • Last Date : 28 August 2021
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 August 2021
  • PET / PST Test Start : From 28 January 2026
  • PET / PST Admit Card : 13 January 2026
  • PET / PST Date : From 09 February 2026 (Remaining Candidates)
  • PET / PST Admit Card : 04 February 2026 (Remaining Candidates)
  • Written Exam Date : 07 July 2026
  • Written Admit Card : 03 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 09 July 2026
  • Result : 14 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, ESM : 0/-
  • All Female Candidates : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

SSB Head Constable Ministerial Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
